card.name: Just before blood pressure terms
card.fires_on: Words and word parts right before an expected hypertension or blood pressure term, such as 'ant' in antihypertensive, 'elevated' before blood pressure, or 'g' in mmHg.

modes.description: The 'g' of mmHg after a blood pressure number.
